generation_params.prompt:

Keep the supplied established world and physical designs. No title, panel label, shot ID, subtitles, dialogue, timestamp, watermark or production annotation is burned into the image. One natural held pose at the beginning of the described beat; do not try to show a whole shot’s duration or multiple actions in one image. Any dialogue supplied separately is performance context only and must never appear as words in the picture. Use only the specified visible cast; realistic feline/canine paws, no human fingers, extra limbs, merged bodies, duplicate faces or borrowed accessories. Reference sheets provide identity/material evidence only: never copy their panel layout, text or labels into this single frame. Physical continuity: north wall has the ONE CRT with exactly two knobs on its own right and ONE CatStation5 above it. The patched brown couch faces north toward that television. The outside/emblem back is south. The west-side southwest passage is fixed. There are exactly FIVE seat cushions. In the true front reverse from the TV looking south, west/southwest passage is frame-RIGHT, east/window side frame-LEFT, and the TV/console are behind the camera, absent from the image. Exactly five crew cats, seated screen-left to right NEON, ONYX, TRIXIE, BYTE, GHOST. No sixth actor. Keep five separate torso/head silhouettes and one assigned controller per cat in natural furred paws. They face away from camera toward the TV; do not turn all five back toward camera.
